$note: 生年化忌嘅留意句，逐宮一句（2026-10-17 · docs/leads-audit-2026-10-17.md B5）。以前每粒星一句，十二宮通用：太陰化忌落財帛都係講「把感受壓得很深」。而家意思照跟 modifiers/sihua.json 嗰粒星嘅化忌句，只係收窄到嗰宮講嘅方面，唔加新象義。命宮照用 palace-plain.ts JI_WATCH。第一截要有 epilogue.ts AREA_WORDS 嘅方面字，給你的話先唔會再加多次方面。

兄弟.zh: 要留意的是：朋輩之間的事，你容易想來想去，遲遲不肯下定論。
兄弟.en: The catch: between you and your peers, you can go round and round a matter and put off reaching a conclusion.

夫妻.zh: 要留意的是：感情上你容易反覆推敲對方的意思，想得停不下來。
夫妻.en: The catch: in love you can keep turning over what your partner meant, unable to stop thinking about it.

子女.zh: 要留意的是：帶後輩時你的安排容易改了又改，自己也收不了尾。
子女.en: The catch: with those you bring up, your plans can change again and again, and you struggle to wrap them up.

財帛.zh: 要留意的是：錢方面你容易反覆盤算，方案一改再改，遲遲定不下來。
財帛.en: The catch: with money you can keep recalculating, changing the plan again and again without settling on one.

疾厄.zh: 要留意的是：身心上你最耗的是想個不停，腦子很難真正停下來休息。
疾厄.en: The catch: what wears on you most is thinking without pause; your mind finds it hard to truly stop and rest.

遷移.zh: 要留意的是：在外你容易對去留反覆推演，想得多，動得慢。
遷移.en: The catch: away from home you can keep weighing whether to stay or go, thinking a lot and moving slowly.

僕役.zh: 要留意的是：朋友之間的事，你容易想來想去，同一件事放不下。
僕役.en: The catch: with friends, you can go round and round the same matter and not let it go.

官祿.zh: 要留意的是：工作上你容易把方案反覆推演，到了該收尾時還在改。
官祿.en: The catch: at work you can keep reworking a plan, still changing it when it's time to finish.

田宅.zh: 要留意的是：住的安排你容易想來想去，搬不搬、怎麼佈置都遲遲定不下來。
田宅.en: The catch: with where you live, you can go round and round — whether to move, how to arrange things — without deciding.

福德.zh: 要留意的是：心境上你的念頭轉個不停，很難讓自己真正放空。
福德.en: The catch: inwardly your thoughts keep turning, and it's hard to let your mind truly go quiet.

父母.zh: 要留意的是：對長輩和上司的意思，你容易反覆揣摩，想得停不下來。
父母.en: The catch: you can keep second-guessing what your elders and superiors mean, unable to stop thinking about it.

兄弟.zh: 要留意的是：朋輩之間你付出得多，回應卻常常跟不上，久了會心淡。
兄弟.en: The catch: you give a lot to your peers, but the response often falls short, and over time your warmth cools.

夫妻.zh: 要留意的是：感情上你付出得多，對方的回應卻常常跟不上你的熱度。
夫妻.en: The catch: in love you give a lot, but your partner's response often can't keep up with your warmth.

子女.zh: 要留意的是：帶後輩時你給得多，回應卻常常跟不上，最耗的是你的熱心。
子女.en: The catch: you give a lot to those you bring up, but the response often falls short, and what it drains most is your goodwill.

財帛.zh: 要留意的是：錢方面你容易花出去的多、收回來的少，付出和回報之間有缺口。
財帛.en: The catch: with money, more tends to go out than comes back, leaving a gap between what you put in and what you get.

疾厄.zh: 要留意的是：身心上你耗得最多的是熱度，給出去太多，自己卻沒補回來。
疾厄.en: The catch: what wears on you most is spent warmth — you give out too much and don't top yourself back up.

遷移.zh: 要留意的是：在外你出力不少，別人的回應卻常常跟不上你的付出。
遷移.en: The catch: out in the world you put in plenty, but others' response often falls short of what you give.

僕役.zh: 要留意的是：朋友圈裡你出錢出力，回應卻常常跟不上，最耗的是熱度。
僕役.en: The catch: among friends you give money and effort, but the response often falls short, and what it drains most is your warmth.

官祿.zh: 要留意的是：工作上你付出得多，認可卻常常來得慢，最耗的是你的幹勁。
官祿.en: The catch: at work you give a lot, but recognition is often slow to come, and what it drains most is your drive.

田宅.zh: 要留意的是：家裡的事你付出得多，家人的回應卻常常跟不上。
田宅.en: The catch: at home you give a lot, but your family's response often falls short.

福德.zh: 要留意的是：心境上你最耗的是熱度，給出去的多，回到自己身上的少。
福德.en: The catch: inwardly what wears on you most is warmth — much goes out, little comes back to you.

父母.zh: 要留意的是：對長輩和上司你付出得多，換來的回應卻常常不如預期。
父母.en: The catch: you give a lot to your elders and superiors, but the response is often less than you hoped.

兄弟.zh: 要留意的是：你和朋輩想一起做的事容易卡住，做成了也可能比預期吃力。
兄弟.en: The catch: what you and your peers want to do together can easily get stuck, and even when it gets done, it may take more than you expected.

夫妻.zh: 要留意的是：感情上你想定下來的事容易卡住，硬碰硬時代價更大。
夫妻.en: The catch: in love, what you want to settle can easily get stuck, and meeting force with force costs more.

子女.zh: 要留意的是：帶後輩時你定下的事容易卡住，硬推只會更費力。
子女.en: The catch: with those you bring up, what you've decided can easily get stuck, and pushing harder only takes more effort.

財帛.zh: 要留意的是：錢方面你想做的決定容易卡住，做成了花費也可能超出預期。
財帛.en: The catch: with money, the decisions you want to make can easily get stuck, and even when they go through, the cost may run over.

疾厄.zh: 要留意的是：身心上你習慣硬撐，事情卡住時，最先吃虧的是自己的體力。
疾厄.en: The catch: you're used to forcing your way through, so when things get stuck, your own stamina pays first.

遷移.zh: 要留意的是：在外你想辦的事容易卡住，就算辦成，代價也可能比預期高。
遷移.en: The catch: away from home, what you set out to do can easily get stuck, and even when it's done, the cost may be higher than expected.

僕役.zh: 要留意的是：你和朋友合作的事容易卡住，硬碰硬時最容易傷和氣。
僕役.en: The catch: what you work on with friends can easily get stuck, and meeting force with force is what most easily spoils the goodwill.

官祿.zh: 要留意的是：工作上你想推的事容易卡住，做成了也可能比預期吃力。
官祿.en: The catch: at work, what you want to push through can easily get stuck, and even when it gets done, it may take more than you expected.

田宅.zh: 要留意的是：住的事你想定下來卻容易卡住，花費也常比預期多。
田宅.en: The catch: when you want to settle where you live, things can easily get stuck, and the cost often runs over.

福德.zh: 要留意的是：心境上你想做而做不成的事，容易積成一股悶氣。
福德.en: The catch: inwardly, what you want to do but can't can build into a pent-up frustration.

父母.zh: 要留意的是：對長輩和上司，你想定的事容易卡住，硬碰硬時更難轉圜。
父母.en: The catch: with elders and superiors, what you want to settle can easily get stuck, and meeting force with force leaves less room to turn things round.

兄弟.zh: 要留意的是：朋輩之間你想相處得舒服，條件卻常常湊不齊，事情容易拖著。
兄弟.en: The catch: you want things easy with your peers, but the conditions often don't come together, and matters tend to drag.

夫妻.zh: 要留意的是：感情上你想安頓下來，條件卻常常湊不齊，關係容易拖著。
夫妻.en: The catch: in love you want to settle, but the conditions often don't come together, and the relationship tends to drag.

子女.zh: 要留意的是：帶後輩時你想輕鬆一點，條件卻常常不配合，事情容易拖。
子女.en: The catch: with those you bring up you'd like it easier, but conditions often don't cooperate, and things tend to drag.

財帛.zh: 要留意的是：錢方面你想過得舒服，條件卻常常湊不齊，該處理的事容易拖著。
財帛.en: The catch: with money you want to live comfortably, but the conditions often don't come together, and what needs handling tends to drag.

疾厄.zh: 要留意的是：身心上你需要的休息常常湊不齊，疲累容易拖著不散。
疾厄.en: The catch: the rest you need often doesn't come together, and tiredness tends to linger.

遷移.zh: 要留意的是：在外你想安頓下來，條件卻常常湊不齊，落腳的事容易拖著。
遷移.en: The catch: away from home you want to settle, but the conditions often don't come together, and finding your footing tends to drag.

僕役.zh: 要留意的是：朋友圈裡你想相處得舒服，該說的事卻容易一拖再拖。
僕役.en: The catch: among friends you want things easy, so what needs saying tends to be put off again and again.

官祿.zh: 要留意的是：工作上你想做得安穩，條件卻常常湊不齊，進度容易拖著。
官祿.en: The catch: at work you want things steady, but the conditions often don't come together, and progress tends to drag.

田宅.zh: 要留意的是：住的方面你想安頓下來，條件卻常常湊不齊，安家的事容易拖。
田宅.en: The catch: with where you live you want to settle, but the conditions often don't come together, and making a home tends to drag.

福德.zh: 要留意的是：心境上你想舒服，卻常常差一點條件，悶悶的感覺容易拖著。
福德.en: The catch: inwardly you want ease, but something is often just missing, and a dull, low feeling tends to linger.

父母.zh: 要留意的是：對長輩和上司你想相處得舒服，該談的事卻容易拖著不談。
父母.en: The catch: you want things easy with your elders and superiors, so what needs discussing tends to be left undiscussed.

兄弟.zh: 要留意的是：朋輩之間你投入了卻得不到回應時，情緒容易比事情更大。
兄弟.en: The catch: when you've invested in your peers and get no response, your feelings can run bigger than the matter itself.

夫妻.zh: 要留意的是：感情上你投入了卻得不到回應時，反應容易比事情本身大。
夫妻.en: The catch: in love, when you've invested and get no response, your reaction can run bigger than the matter itself.

子女.zh: 要留意的是：帶後輩時你用心卻得不到回應，情緒容易比事情來得大。
子女.en: The catch: when you put your heart into those you bring up and get no response, your feelings can run bigger than the matter.

財帛.zh: 要留意的是：錢方面你堅持的原則容易被現實卡住，一卡住情緒就上來。
財帛.en: The catch: with money, the principles you hold to can easily run into reality, and once they do, your feelings flare.

疾厄.zh: 要留意的是：身心上你投入太多又得不到回應時，情緒最耗你的力氣。
疾厄.en: The catch: when you've invested too much and get no response, it's your feelings that drain your strength most.

遷移.zh: 要留意的是：在外你的原則容易被現實卡住，反應容易比事情本身大。
遷移.en: The catch: out in the world your principles can easily run into reality, and your reaction can run bigger than the matter itself.

僕役.zh: 要留意的是：朋友之間你投入了卻得不到回應時，容易一下子反應很大。
僕役.en: The catch: when you've invested in friends and get no response, you can react strongly all at once.

官祿.zh: 要留意的是：工作上你的原則容易被現實卡住，反應容易比事情本身大。
官祿.en: The catch: at work your principles can easily run into reality, and your reaction can run bigger than the matter itself.

田宅.zh: 要留意的是：家裡的事你投入了卻得不到回應時，情緒容易比事情更大。
田宅.en: The catch: at home, when you've invested and get no response, your feelings can run bigger than the matter itself.

福德.zh: 要留意的是：心境上你投入的事一沒有回應，情緒就容易翻得比事情大。
福德.en: The catch: inwardly, as soon as what you've invested in gets no response, your feelings can swell bigger than the matter.

父母.zh: 要留意的是：對長輩和上司你投入了卻得不到回應時，情緒容易比事情更大。
父母.en: The catch: when you've invested in your elders and superiors and get no response, your feelings can run bigger than the matter itself.

兄弟.zh: 要留意的是：朋輩之間你把感受收得很緊，心裡有事也很少說出口。
兄弟.en: The catch: with your peers you hold your feelings in tightly, and even when something's on your mind you seldom say it.

夫妻.zh: 要留意的是：感情上你把感受壓得很深，心裡積了很多，對方卻未必知道。
夫妻.en: The catch: in love you press your feelings down deep; a lot builds up inside, and your partner may not know.

子女.zh: 要留意的是：帶後輩時你的擔心收在心裡，積了很多，嘴上卻很少說。
子女.en: The catch: with those you bring up, you keep your worries to yourself; a lot builds up, but little gets said.

財帛.zh: 要留意的是：錢方面你的顧慮收在心裡，越積越多，卻很少和人商量。
財帛.en: The catch: with money you keep your worries to yourself; they pile up, but you seldom talk them over with anyone.

疾厄.zh: 要留意的是：身心上你的情緒往內積，不說出來，就會慢慢變成疲累。
疾厄.en: The catch: your feelings build up inside, and when they go unspoken, they slowly turn into tiredness.

遷移.zh: 要留意的是：在外你把感受收得很緊，不習慣的地方也很少說出口。
遷移.en: The catch: away from home you hold your feelings in tightly, and seldom say what you find hard to get used to.

僕役.zh: 要留意的是：朋友之間你把不滿收在心裡，積了很多，嘴上卻很少說。
僕役.en: The catch: with friends you keep your grievances to yourself; a lot builds up, but little gets said.

官祿.zh: 要留意的是：工作上你把壓力收在心裡，積了很多，卻很少向人開口。
官祿.en: The catch: at work you keep the pressure to yourself; a lot builds up, but you seldom speak to anyone about it.

田宅.zh: 要留意的是：家裡的事你把感受收得很緊，住得不舒服也很少說。
田宅.en: The catch: at home you hold your feelings in tightly, and even when living there doesn't feel right, you seldom say so.

福德.zh: 要留意的是：心境上你習慣把事情悶在心裡，越積越重，卻很少找出口。
福德.en: The catch: inwardly you tend to keep things bottled up; they grow heavier, yet you seldom look for a way out.

父母.zh: 要留意的是：對長輩和上司你把感受壓在心裡，有話也很少說出口。
父母.en: The catch: with elders and superiors you keep your feelings pressed down, and even when you have something to say, you seldom say it.

兄弟.zh: 要留意的是：朋輩之間你容易暗暗比較，比不上的那一樣會一直纏在心上。
兄弟.en: The catch: among your peers you can quietly compare, and the one thing you fall short on stays wound around your mind.

夫妻.zh: 要留意的是：感情上你求而不得的那一樣，很容易一直纏在心上。
夫妻.en: The catch: in love, the one thing you want and can't get easily stays wound around your mind.

子女.zh: 要留意的是：帶後輩時你期望的那一樣做不到，很容易一直放不下。
子女.en: The catch: with those you bring up, when the one thing you hoped for doesn't happen, you can find it hard to let go.

財帛.zh: 要留意的是：錢方面你想要而得不到的東西，很容易轉成比較和不甘。
財帛.en: The catch: with money, what you want and can't get easily turns into comparison and resentment.

疾厄.zh: 要留意的是：身心上你最耗的是不甘心，得不到的那一樣會一直佔著心思。
疾厄.en: The catch: what wears on you most is not being able to let it go — the one thing you can't get keeps taking up your thoughts.

遷移.zh: 要留意的是：在外你容易和人比較，想要而得不到時，心裡特別不甘。
遷移.en: The catch: out in the world you can compare yourself with others, and when you want something and can't get it, it rankles.

僕役.zh: 要留意的是：朋友圈裡你容易暗暗比較，得不到的那一樣會一直纏在心上。
僕役.en: The catch: among friends you can quietly compare, and the one thing you can't get stays wound around your mind.

官祿.zh: 要留意的是：工作上你想要而得不到的位置，很容易一直纏在心上。
官祿.en: The catch: at work, the position you want and can't get easily stays wound around your mind.

田宅.zh: 要留意的是：住的方面你想要而得不到的那一樣，很容易一直放不下。
田宅.en: The catch: with where you live, the one thing you want and can't get is hard to let go.

福德.zh: 要留意的是：心境上你得不到的那一樣，最容易佔滿心思。
福德.en: The catch: inwardly, the one thing you can't get is what most easily fills your thoughts.

父母.zh: 要留意的是：對長輩和上司你求而不得的那一樣，很容易一直放不下。
父母.en: The catch: with elders and superiors, the one thing you want and can't get is hard to let go.

兄弟.zh: 要留意的是：朋輩之間你的話容易被誤解，越想說清楚，越容易糾纏。
兄弟.en: The catch: with your peers your words are easily misunderstood, and the harder you try to make them clear, the more tangled it gets.

夫妻.zh: 要留意的是：感情上你說出口的話容易被誤解，越解釋越容易糾纏。
夫妻.en: The catch: in love what you say is easily misunderstood, and the more you explain, the more tangled it gets.

子女.zh: 要留意的是：帶後輩時你的話容易被聽錯，越想講清楚，越容易糾纏。
子女.en: The catch: with those you bring up your words are easily misheard, and the harder you try to make them clear, the more tangled it gets.

財帛.zh: 要留意的是：錢方面你口頭講好的事容易被誤解，最好寫下來。
財帛.en: The catch: with money, what's agreed by word of mouth is easily misunderstood, so it's best to write it down.

疾厄.zh: 要留意的是：身心上你最耗的是話說不清的糾纏，越想解釋越累。
疾厄.en: The catch: what wears on you most is the tangle of things that can't be said clearly, and the more you explain, the more tired you get.

遷移.zh: 要留意的是：在外你說的話容易被誤解，越想解釋，越容易糾纏。
遷移.en: The catch: out in the world what you say is easily misunderstood, and the more you try to explain, the more tangled it gets.

僕役.zh: 要留意的是：朋友之間你的話容易被誤解，越想說清楚，越容易糾纏。
僕役.en: The catch: with friends your words are easily misunderstood, and the harder you try to make them clear, the more tangled it gets.

官祿.zh: 要留意的是：工作上你說的話容易被誤解，越想講清楚，越容易糾纏。
官祿.en: The catch: at work what you say is easily misunderstood, and the harder you try to make it clear, the more tangled it gets.

田宅.zh: 要留意的是：家裡你說的話容易被誤解，越想說清楚，越容易糾纏。
田宅.en: The catch: at home what you say is easily misunderstood, and the harder you try to make it clear, the more tangled it gets.

福德.zh: 要留意的是：心境上你容易把別人的話反覆咀嚼，越想越糾纏。
福德.en: The catch: inwardly you can keep chewing over what others said, and the more you think, the more tangled it gets.

父母.zh: 要留意的是：對長輩和上司你說的話容易被誤解，越解釋越糾纏。
父母.en: The catch: with elders and superiors what you say is easily misunderstood, and the more you explain, the more tangled it gets.
